headline: The Electrician Master 20
threshold: By Lesson 20, you can teach an apprentice the test-before-you-touch order, explain a hidden problem and a change order to a client, say no to an unsafe request, report an incident or near miss in writing and aloud, and run a full day after a basement flood in Spanish.

lessons.title: Why We Test Before We Touch: Teaching the Order
lessons.objective: Teach a new apprentice the verification order at a panel and explain the reason for each step.

words.en: First we turn off the breaker and put the lock on it.
words.es: Primero apagamos el breaker y le ponemos el candado.

words.en: Then we measure with the meter to confirm there is no voltage.
words.es: Luego medimos con el multímetro para confirmar que no hay voltaje.

words.en: We test the meter on a live source before trusting it.
words.es: Probamos el medidor en una fuente viva antes de confiar en él.

words.en: A breaker that is off guarantees nothing, so we measure again.
words.es: Un breaker apagado no garantiza nada, por eso medimos otra vez.

words.en: Don't put your hand in until I tell you.
words.es: No metas la mano hasta que yo te diga.

words.en: Did you understand why we do each step?
It's normal to be nervous; that's why we go slowly and together.
words.es: Es normal tener nervios; por eso vamos despacio y juntos.

words.en: Please confirm the reading yourself before continuing.
words.es: Por favor, confirme usted la lectura antes de continuar.

lessons.speaking: You are the journeyman at an open panel, and the AI is a nervous new apprentice: teach the order (lockout, meter test, test again) and explain the reason for each step using primero, luego, porque and por eso.

grammar.focus: Connectors for sequence and cause (primero, luego, porque, por eso)

examples.es: Primero apagamos el circuito; luego lo medimos.
examples.en: First we turn off the circuit; then we measure it.

examples.es: Medimos otra vez porque el breaker puede estar mal etiquetado.
examples.en: We measure again because the breaker may be labeled wrong.

lessons.title: How a Breaker Protects the Wire, Not the Appliance
lessons.objective: Explain in plain Spanish what a breaker protects and what usually happens when it trips.

words.en: If there is an overload, the breaker trips to protect the wire.
words.es: Si hay sobrecarga, el breaker se dispara para proteger el cable.

words.en: It trips because the wire can't handle more current.
words.es: Se dispara porque el cable no aguanta más corriente.

words.en: The breaker protects the wire, not the appliance.
words.es: El breaker protege el cable, no el aparato.

words.en: If you put in a bigger breaker, the wire overheats.
words.es: Si usted pone un breaker más grande, el cable se sobrecalienta.

words.en: That is not done; it can cause a fire.
words.es: Eso no se hace; puede causar un incendio.

words.en: The breaker is chosen according to the wire and the local code.
words.es: El breaker se escoge según el cable y el código local.

words.en: Which appliances are used at the same time on this circuit?
words.es: ¿Qué aparatos se usan al mismo tiempo en este circuito?

words.en: If it trips often, call us to check the circuit.
words.es: Si se dispara seguido, llámenos para revisar el circuito.

lessons.speaking: You are the electrician at a kitchen table, and the AI is a homeowner's adult son asking about the tripping: explain what a breaker protects and what usually happens when it trips, using se dispara and si + present.

grammar.focus: Impersonal se; si + present for general truths (se dispara, si hay sobrecarga...)

examples.es: Si hay sobrecarga, el breaker se dispara.
examples.en: If there is an overload, the breaker trips.

examples.es: Se dispara para que el cable no se caliente demasiado.
examples.en: It trips so the wire doesn't get too hot.

lessons.title: Read the Panel Directory Before You Swap a Breaker
lessons.objective: Direct an apprentice to check the panel label and directory, and to confirm each step before swapping a breaker.

words.note: The list of what each breaker feeds.

words.en: Check it again before removing the breaker.
words.es: Revísalo otra vez antes de quitar el breaker.

words.en: Don't touch it yet; first read the label.
words.es: No lo toques todavía; primero lee la etiqueta.

words.en: Read it aloud so we can verify it together.
words.es: Léelo en voz alta para que lo verifiquemos juntos.

words.en: Tell me if the directory doesn't match the label.
words.es: Dímelo si el directorio no coincide con la etiqueta.

words.en: Don't swap it until you confirm which circuit it is.
words.es: No lo cambies hasta confirmar cuál circuito es.

words.en: According to the label on the door, this breaker is 20 amps.
words.es: Según la etiqueta de la puerta, este breaker es de 20 amperios.

words.en: Show it to me before turning anything off.

lessons.speaking: You are the electrician in a basement, and the AI is your apprentice about to replace a breaker: direct them to check the panel label and directory, using commands with pronouns like revísalo, no lo toques and léelo en voz alta.

grammar.focus: Commands with object pronouns (revísalo, no lo toques, léelo en voz alta)

examples.es: Léelo en voz alta, por favor.
examples.en: Read it aloud, please.

examples.es: No lo toques hasta confirmar el circuito.
examples.en: Don't touch it until you confirm the circuit.

lessons.title: Smart Dimmer Instructions: Read the Maker's Load Limits
lessons.objective: Read a manufacturer instruction sheet aloud and explain its limits and steps to an apprentice.

words.en: Before installing it, we have to read the whole instruction sheet.
words.es: Antes de instalarlo, hay que leer toda la hoja de instrucciones.

words.en: According to the sheet, the maximum with LED is 150 watts.
words.es: Según la hoja, el máximo con LED es 150 vatios.

words.en: After turning off the breaker, we have to test that there is no voltage.
words.es: Después de apagar el breaker, hay que probar que no hay voltaje.

words.en: We have to confirm that the bulbs are dimmable.
words.es: Hay que confirmar que los focos son regulables.

words.en: Before buying another one, let's check the compatibility list.
words.es: Antes de comprar otro, vamos a revisar la lista de compatibilidad.

words.en: This fixture doesn't appear on the manufacturer's sheet.
words.es: Esta luminaria no aparece en la hoja del fabricante.

words.en: Before connecting the load wire, read the warning.
words.es: Antes de conectar el cable de carga, lee la advertencia.

words.en: Ma'am, according to the sheet, that fixture isn't compatible with this dimmer.
words.es: Señora, según la hoja, esa luminaria no es compatible con este atenuador.

lessons.speaking: You are the electrician, and the AI is your apprentice in a living room: read the smart dimmer's Spanish instruction sheet aloud and explain its load limits and steps, using antes de / después de + infinitive and hay que.

grammar.focus: Antes de / después de + infinitive; hay que

examples.es: Antes de instalar el atenuador, hay que apagar el breaker.
examples.en: Before installing the dimmer, we have to turn off the breaker.

examples.es: Después de leer la hoja, confirmamos la carga máxima.
examples.en: After reading the sheet, we confirm the maximum load.

lessons.title: Aluminum Wiring Behind the Wall: Change Order
lessons.objective: Tell a homeowner what you found, what you did, and propose a repair with a change order.

words.note: Compatible with both metals, per the connector maker.

words.en: When I opened the wall, I found aluminum wiring.
words.es: Al abrir la pared, encontré cableado de aluminio.

words.en: The insulation was brittle and the connections were loose.
words.es: El aislante estaba quebradizo y las conexiones estaban flojas.

words.en: I turned off the circuit and measured before touching anything.
words.es: Apagué el circuito y medí antes de tocar algo.

words.en: I would propose repairing the connections with compatible connectors.
words.es: Yo propondría reparar las conexiones con conectores compatibles.

words.en: This changes the scope and the price; let me explain why.
words.es: Esto cambia el alcance y el precio; le explico por qué.

words.en: I understand your concern; we won't continue without your approval.
words.es: Entiendo su preocupación; no seguiremos sin su aprobación.
words.note: Formal; calming tone for a worried owner.

words.en: I would recommend an inspection after the repair.
words.es: Le recomendaría una inspección después de la reparación.

words.en: I'll send you the change order in writing with the additional cost.
words.es: Le mando por escrito la orden de cambio con el costo adicional.

lessons.speaking: You are the electrician, and the AI is a worried homeowner: explain what you found behind the wall, what you did, and propose a repair with a change order, using encontré, estaba and yo propondría.

grammar.focus: Preterite vs imperfect; conditional for the proposal (encontré, estaba, yo propondría)

examples.es: Cuando abrí la pared, el cableado estaba oxidado.
examples.en: When I opened the wall, the wiring was corroded.

examples.es: Yo propondría reparar las conexiones primero.
examples.en: I would propose repairing the connections first.

lessons.title: Backordered Breaker: Substitution at the Supply House
lessons.objective: Discuss a backordered breaker with a supply-house clerk and agree on a compatible substitute, checking the label.

words.en: When will the breaker I ordered arrive?
How long will the backorder take?
words.es: ¿Cuánto va a tardar el pedido pendiente?

words.en: Is there another branch with that model in stock?
words.es: ¿Hay otra sucursal con ese modelo en inventario?

words.en: That model costs more than the original, right?
words.es: Ese modelo es más caro que el original, ¿verdad?

words.en: Is this one just as compatible with my panel?
words.es: ¿Este es igual de compatible con mi panel?

words.en: According to the panel label, only certain models work.
words.es: Según la etiqueta del panel, solo sirven ciertos modelos.

words.en: Let me read the label before deciding.
words.es: Déjeme leer la etiqueta antes de decidir.

words.en: I'm going to check the manufacturer's list before buying it.
words.es: Voy a revisar la lista del fabricante antes de comprarlo.

lessons.speaking: You are the electrician, and the AI is a supply-house clerk: ask when the backordered breaker will arrive, compare the alternatives, and check the panel label before agreeing, using llegará, va a tardar and más caro que.

grammar.focus: Future and ir a; comparisons (llegará, va a tardar, es más caro que, igual de compatible)

examples.es: El breaker llegará el viernes, pero va a tardar más si hay retraso.
examples.en: The breaker will arrive Friday, but it will take longer if there is a delay.

examples.es: Según la etiqueta, este modelo es igual de compatible con el panel.
examples.en: According to the label, this model is just as compatible with the panel.

lessons.title: Utility Crew Arrives While the Service Is Open
lessons.objective: Narrate what happened on site and give readings and times clearly to a utility crew under pressure.

words.en: I turned off the main breaker at 10:15.
words.es: Desconecté el breaker principal a las 10:15.
words.note: Say: a las diez y cuarto.

words.en: I put on my lock and tag at 10:20.
words.es: Puse mi candado y mi etiqueta a las 10:20.
words.note: Say: a las diez y veinte.

words.en: I measured again at 10:30 and there was no voltage.
words.es: Medí otra vez a las 10:30 y no había voltaje.

words.en: The meter read 0 volts on the load side.
words.es: El medidor marcó 0 voltios en el lado de carga.

words.en: No one touched the meter seal since I arrived.
words.es: Nadie tocó el sello del medidor desde que llegué.

words.en: Please don't reconnect until I remove my lock.
words.es: Por favor, no reconecten hasta que yo quite mi candado.

words.en: I don't have that reading; I'd rather measure again than guess.
words.es: No tengo esa lectura; prefiero medir otra vez que adivinar.

words.en: Can you show me your work order, please?
words.es: ¿Me puede mostrar su orden de trabajo, por favor?

lessons.speaking: You are the electrician on site, and the AI is a utility crew lead who just arrived: report in the preterite what you disconnected, at what times, and what the meter read, without guessing.

grammar.focus: Preterite narration; numbers under pressure (a las diez y cuarto, el medidor marcó...)

examples.es: Llegué a las 9:00 y desconecté el servicio a las 9:10.
examples.en: I arrived at 9:00 and disconnected the service at 9:10.

examples.es: El medidor marcó 0 voltios cuando medí.
examples.en: The meter read 0 volts when I measured.

lessons.title: Saying No to Bypassing a Tripping Breaker
lessons.objective: Refuse a landlord's request to bypass a tripping breaker, explain the risk, and offer a safe alternative.

words.en: Please don't bypass it; it can cause a fire.
words.es: No lo puentee, por favor; puede causar un incendio.

words.en: I don't recommend that you replace the breaker with a bigger one.
words.es: No recomiendo que cambie el breaker por uno más grande.
words.note: Formal; subjunctive after no recomiendo que.

words.en: I understand the pressure, but I can't make that change.
words.es: Entiendo la presión, pero no puedo hacer ese cambio.

words.en: It trips because something in the circuit isn't right.
words.es: Se dispara porque algo en el circuito no está bien.

words.en: I propose a visit to find the root cause.
words.es: Le propongo una visita para encontrar la causa raíz.

words.en: Don't plug more appliances into that circuit in the meantime.
words.es: No conecten más aparatos en ese circuito mientras tanto.
words.note: Plural command, passed on to the tenants.

words.en: We can check the circuit tomorrow first thing.
words.es: Podemos revisar el circuito mañana a primera hora.

words.en: I'll give you a report so the tenant can see it.
words.es: Le doy un informe para que el inquilino lo vea.

lessons.speaking: You are the electrician, and the AI is a landlord whose tenant keeps complaining about a tripping breaker: decline any unsafe fix, explain the risk, and offer an inspection, using no lo puentee and no recomiendo que.

grammar.focus: Negative commands; subjunctive after no recomiendo que (no lo puentee, no recomiendo que cambie...)

examples.es: No lo puentee; es peligroso.
examples.en: Don't bypass it; it's dangerous.

examples.es: No recomiendo que cambie el breaker sin revisar el cable.
examples.en: I don't recommend that you change the breaker without checking the wire.

lessons.title: Feedback for an Apprentice Who Rushes Terminations
lessons.objective: Give respectful, specific feedback to an apprentice and state what you want them to do differently.

words.note: The strip-length marking on the device or its instructions.
Often said this way on US jobs; the label gives the value.

words.en: I want you to check every connection against the device instructions.
words.es: Quiero que revises cada conexión con las instrucciones del dispositivo.

words.en: I recommend that you take your time on each terminal.
words.es: Te recomiendo que te tomes el tiempo en cada terminal.

words.en: You did good work today, but I want you not to rush.
words.es: Hoy hiciste buen trabajo, pero quiero que no te apures.

words.en: I need you to strip the wire using the device's guide.
words.es: Necesito que peles el cable con la guía del dispositivo.

words.en: Tighten it to the torque the manufacturer specifies.
words.es: Apriétalo con el torque que indique el fabricante.

words.en: I ask that you tell me if anything isn't clear.
words.es: Te pido que me avises si algo no queda claro.

words.en: I'd rather you ask than guess.
words.es: Prefiero que preguntes a que adivines.

words.en: When you finish, I want you to show me each connection.
words.es: Cuando termines, quiero que me enseñes cada conexión.

lessons.speaking: You are the electrician giving private feedback at the truck, and the AI is your apprentice: praise something specific, name the skipped check, and say what you want next using quiero que… and te recomiendo que…

grammar.focus: Present subjunctive after wishes and recommendations (quiero que revises, te recomiendo que...)

examples.es: Quiero que revises las instrucciones antes de conectar.
examples.en: I want you to check the instructions before connecting.

examples.es: Te recomiendo que uses el pelacables con la guía.
examples.en: I recommend that you use the wire stripper with the guide.

lessons.title: Who Left the Panel Open? Settling a Crew Dispute
lessons.objective: Hear two crew members' versions, report what each said, and settle the conflict with a clear agreement.

words.en: Carlos, what did you tell Luis before you left?
words.es: Carlos, ¿qué le dijiste a Luis antes de irte?

words.en: Luis, what were you doing when the shift ended?
words.es: Luis, ¿qué estabas haciendo cuando terminó el turno?

words.en: Carlos said he thought you were going to close the panel.
words.es: Carlos dijo que creía que tú ibas a cerrar el panel.

words.en: Luis, you were saying you had already put the tools away.
words.es: Luis, tú decías que ya habías guardado las herramientas.

words.en: The homeowner said she saw the panel open in the morning.
words.es: La señora dijo que vio el panel abierto en la mañana.

words.en: I heard both of you; now I'll repeat what I understood.
words.es: Escuché a los dos; ahora les repito lo que entendí.

words.en: I'm not looking for someone to blame; I want it not to happen again.
words.es: No busco culpables; busco que no vuelva a pasar.

words.en: From today, the last one out checks the cover and signs.
words.es: Desde hoy, el último en salir revisa la cubierta y firma.

lessons.speaking: You are the lead electrician mediating in the van, and the AI plays the two crew members blaming each other: hear each version, report what each said with dijo que / decía que and estaba, then set a clear agreement.

grammar.focus: Reported speech; imperfect for background (dijo que, estaba, decía que)

examples.es: Luis dijo que ya estaba oscuro al salir.
examples.en: Luis said it was already dark when he left.

examples.es: Carlos decía que la cubierta estaba puesta.
examples.en: Carlos was saying the cover was on.

lessons.title: Keeping the Crew Steady in a Hot Attic Week
lessons.objective: Encourage a tired crew, make clear commitments about breaks and schedule, and ask how they feel.

words.en: We'll take breaks in the shade and drink water often.
words.es: Haremos pausas en la sombra y tomaremos agua cada rato.

words.en: Tomorrow we'll start at 6 and leave before the worst heat.
words.es: Mañana entraremos a las 6 y saldremos antes del calor fuerte.

words.en: We'll always have cold water and ice in the truck.
words.es: Siempre tendremos agua fría y hielo en la troca.

words.en: If someone feels unwell, they'll stop and tell me.
words.es: Si alguien se siente mal, parará y me avisará.

words.en: I'll talk to the client to adjust the schedule.
words.es: Yo hablaré con el cliente para ajustar el cronograma.

words.en: I know you're tired, and I thank you for the effort.
words.es: Sé que están cansados, y les agradezco el esfuerzo.

words.en: How do you really feel today?
No one will work alone in the attic this week.
words.es: Nadie trabajará solo en el ático esta semana.

lessons.speaking: You are the lead during a hot week, and the AI is a tired, discouraged crew member: encourage them, promise new hours, water and rest breaks with the future (haremos, entraremos), and ask how they feel.

grammar.focus: Future for commitments; encouragement register (haremos pausas, lo vamos a lograr)

examples.es: Mañana empezaremos a las 6.
examples.en: Tomorrow we'll start at 6.

examples.es: Lo vamos a lograr juntos.
examples.en: We're going to make it together.

lessons.title: One Faulty GFCI, Four Listeners: Switching Register
lessons.objective: Explain the same faulty-GFCI problem to a homeowner, an apprentice, a property manager, and an inspector.

words.en: Ma'am, I'd like to explain why this outlet keeps tripping.
words.es: Señora, quisiera explicarle por qué se dispara este tomacorriente.

words.en: If you'll allow me, I'll show you the test button.
words.es: Si me permite, le muestro el botón de prueba.

words.en: I ask that you not use this outlet until we replace it.
words.es: Te pido que no uses este tomacorriente hasta que lo cambiemos.

words.en: Look, the GFCI doesn't respond to the reset button.
words.es: Mira, el GFCI no responde al botón de reposición.

words.en: I'd like to ask your authorization to replace it today.
words.es: Quisiera pedirle autorización para cambiarlo hoy mismo.
words.note: Formal; to the busy property manager.

words.en: In short: it's faulty and I recommend replacing it today.
words.es: En resumen: está defectuoso y recomiendo cambiarlo hoy.
words.note: Short and direct for a busy listener.

words.en: Inspector, could you check the replacement when you have availability?
words.es: Inspector, ¿podría revisar el reemplazo cuando tenga disponibilidad?

words.en: Could you hand me the tester and write down the reading?
words.es: ¿Podrías pasarme el probador y anotar la lectura?
words.note: Informal (tú), softened request to the apprentice.

lessons.speaking: You are the electrician, and the AI plays four listeners in turn: homeowner, apprentice, property manager, inspector. Explain the same faulty GFCI to each, switching usted/tú and using quisiera, ¿podría…? and te pido que.

grammar.focus: Usted / tú switching; softeners (quisiera, ¿podría...?, te pido que)

examples.es: Quisiera pedirle que firme aquí, por favor.
examples.en: I would like to ask you to sign here, please.

examples.es: ¿Podría esperar un momento, señora?
examples.en: Could you wait a moment, ma'am?

lessons.title: Shock Incident: What Happened, Minute by Minute
lessons.objective: Tell a safety officer what happened during a shock incident in order, with times and who was involved.

words.note: Usual word on site for an extension cord.

words.en: At nine we were cutting conduit in the garage.
words.es: A las nueve cortábamos conduit en el garaje.

words.en: Suddenly, Luis yelled and dropped the drill.
words.es: De repente, Luis gritó y soltó el taladro.

words.en: While Pedro called 911, I cut the power.
words.es: Mientras Pedro llamaba al 911, yo corté la corriente.

words.en: Nobody touched Luis until I cut the power.
words.es: Nadie tocó a Luis hasta que corté la corriente.

words.en: After a few minutes, the paramedics arrived.
words.es: Después de unos minutos, llegaron los paramédicos.

words.en: Luis said he felt tingling in his left hand.
words.es: Luis dijo que sentía hormigueo en la mano izquierda.

words.en: It was nine ten when it all happened.
words.es: Eran las nueve y diez cuando pasó todo.

words.en: This is what I saw; I can't say what he felt.
words.es: Esto es lo que vi; no puedo decir qué sintió él.
words.note: Formal-neutral; keeps facts separate from guesses.

lessons.speaking: You are the electrician, and the AI is the company safety officer: give a calm account of the shock incident in order, using past tenses and time markers like a las nueve, de repente, mientras and después de unos minutos.

grammar.focus: Past narration with time markers (a las nueve, de repente, después de unos minutos, mientras)

examples.es: A las nueve, Luis usaba el taladro; de repente, soltó la extensión.
examples.en: At nine, Luis was using the drill; suddenly, he dropped the extension cord.

examples.es: Mientras esperábamos la ambulancia, yo le hablaba para mantenerlo tranquilo.
examples.en: While we waited for the ambulance, I talked to him to keep him calm.

lessons.title: Near Miss: The Unlabeled Circuit That Was Live
lessons.objective: Talk through a near miss without blame, saying what almost happened and what would change next time.

words.en: We almost touched a live wire on that circuit.
words.es: Por poco tocamos un cable vivo en ese circuito.

words.en: You almost touched it, but you stopped in time; well done.
words.es: Casi lo tocas, pero te detuviste a tiempo; bien hecho.

words.en: If we had tested the circuit, we would have known sooner.
words.es: Si hubiéramos probado el circuito, lo habríamos sabido antes.

words.en: It could have been a serious accident.
words.es: Podría haber sido un accidente grave.

words.en: It's not your fault; nobody knew it was live.
words.es: No es culpa tuya; nadie sabía que estaba vivo.

words.en: If the circuit had had a label, we would have asked sooner.
words.es: Si el circuito hubiera tenido etiqueta, habríamos preguntado antes.

words.en: Next time, we test everything, even if it has a label.
words.es: La próxima vez, probamos todo, aunque tenga etiqueta.

words.en: What could we change so it doesn't happen again?
words.es: ¿Qué podríamos cambiar para que no vuelva a pasar?

lessons.speaking: You are the lead electrician, and the AI is your apprentice at the morning shop debrief: talk through the near miss without blame, using casi, por poco, podría haber and si hubiéramos... to say what almost happened and what changes.

grammar.focus: Casi, por poco, podría haber; si clauses (si hubiéramos probado..., por poco nos...)

examples.es: Por poco toco el conductor sin probarlo.
examples.en: I almost touched the conductor without testing it.

examples.es: Si hubiéramos medido primero, nos habríamos ahorrado el susto.
examples.en: If we had measured first, we would have saved ourselves the scare.

lessons.title: Storm Call: Downed Service Mast, Stop Work
lessons.objective: Give short, clear commands to stop work, keep people back, and tell a dispatcher what you see.

words.note: 'El operador' is also heard on 911 calls.

words.en: Stop! Drop everything and move away from the house.
words.es: ¡Alto! Dejen todo y aléjense de la casa.

words.en: Don't touch anything; that wire may be energized.
words.es: No toquen nada; ese cable puede estar energizado.

words.en: Sir, please don't come closer; it's very dangerous.
words.es: Señor, por favor no se acerque; es muy peligroso.

words.en: If anyone comes closer, tell me right away.
words.es: Si alguien se acerca, avísenme de inmediato.

words.en: If you come closer, you can get shocked.
words.es: Si se acerca más, puede recibir una descarga.

words.en: This is an electrician; there's a downed wire at 412 Cedro Street.
words.es: Habla un electricista; hay un cable caído en Calle Cedro 412.

words.en: I need you to notify the power company and the firefighters.
words.es: Necesito que avisen a la compañía eléctrica y a los bomberos.

words.en: The mast is loose and the wire is touching the wet grass.
words.es: El mástil está suelto y el cable toca el pasto mojado.

lessons.speaking: You are the electrician at a storm-damaged house, and the AI is the emergency dispatcher on the phone: say what you see and where you are, and keep your crew back with short commands like aléjense and no toquen.

grammar.focus: Si + present → future; short radio or phone commands (si se acerca, no toquen, aléjense)

examples.es: Si el vecino se acerca, le pediré que retroceda.
examples.en: If the neighbor comes closer, I'll ask him to back up.

examples.es: No toquen el cable; aléjense ahora.
examples.en: Don't touch the wire; move away now.

lessons.title: Auditor Reviews Your Lockout Records
lessons.objective: Answer a safety auditor formally and explain how lockout and testing procedures are carried out and recorded.

words.en: Each lockout is recorded on the form before starting.
words.es: Cada bloqueo se registra en el formulario antes de empezar.

words.en: The absence of voltage is verified with the meter and noted.
words.es: La ausencia de voltaje se verifica con el medidor y se anota.

words.en: No lock is removed without its owner's authorization.
words.es: Ningún candado se quita sin la autorización de su dueño.

words.en: Records are kept in the office and in the truck.
words.es: Los registros se guardan en la oficina y en el camión.

words.en: I'm glad to show you the training records, sir.
words.es: Con gusto le muestro los registros de capacitación, señor.

words.en: A signature is missing on this sheet; it was my mistake.
words.es: Falta una firma en esta hoja; fue un error mío.
words.note: Honest and direct; formal enough for an auditor.

words.en: The signature will be added with today's date.
words.es: La firma se agregará con la fecha de hoy.

words.en: Would you like me to explain how this panel is locked out?
words.es: ¿Desea que le explique cómo se bloquea este panel?

lessons.speaking: You are the electrician, and the AI is a third-party safety auditor: answer formally with usted and explain how lockout and testing are done and recorded, using passive se (se bloquea, se verifica, se registra).

grammar.focus: Formal register; passive se for procedures (se registra, se verifica, se bloquea)

examples.es: El panel se bloquea antes de abrirlo.
examples.en: The panel is locked out before it is opened.

examples.es: Los registros se revisan en la oficina.
examples.en: The records are reviewed in the office.

lessons.title: Daily Report and Photo Log for a Panel Replacement
lessons.objective: Write a clear daily report with a photo log that records what was done, found, tested, and left open.

words.en: First, the existing panel was de-energized and locked out.
words.es: En primer lugar, se desenergizó y se bloqueó el panel existente.

words.en: Afterwards, it was measured that there was no voltage on the bus bars.
words.es: Posteriormente, se midió que no había voltaje en las barras.

words.en: There was corrosion in the box; therefore, the work was expanded.
words.es: Hubo corrosión en la caja; por lo tanto, se amplió el trabajo.

words.en: However, the insulation test remained open until tomorrow.
words.es: No obstante, la prueba de aislamiento quedó pendiente hasta mañana.

words.en: The inspector requested a photo of the new panel's label.
words.es: El inspector solicitó una foto de la etiqueta del panel nuevo.

words.en: I attach the photos with date, time and a caption for each.
words.es: Adjunto las fotos con fecha, hora y descripción de cada una.

words.en: The results are recorded in the attached table.
words.es: Los resultados constan en la tabla adjunta.

words.en: Open for tomorrow: label the circuits and request the reinspection.
words.es: Pendiente para mañana: rotular los circuitos y pedir la reinspección.

lessons.speaking: You are the electrician writing the end-of-day report on a panel replacement, and the AI is the office manager: dictate what you did, found, tested and left open, using en primer lugar, posteriormente, por lo tanto and no obstante.

grammar.focus: Written register; report connectors (en primer lugar, posteriormente, por lo tanto, no obstante)

examples.es: En primer lugar, se desconectó el servicio; posteriormente, se retiró el panel.
examples.en: First, the service was disconnected; afterwards, the panel was removed.

examples.es: Había corrosión; no obstante, las conexiones nuevas pasaron la prueba.
examples.en: There was corrosion; however, the new connections passed the test.

lessons.title: Texts and Calls: Moving a Tenant's Outage Window
lessons.objective: Write texts and make a short call to move a planned outage window politely and confirm the new time.

words.en: Good afternoon, this is Marco, the building's electrician.
words.es: Buenas tardes, le habla Marco, el electricista del edificio.

words.en: I'm writing to confirm the new time of the power shutdown.
words.es: Le escribo para confirmar el nuevo horario del corte de luz.

words.en: Could we move the shutdown to Saturday at 7 a.m.?
words.es: ¿Podríamos mover el corte al sábado a las 7 de la mañana?

words.en: I'm sorry for the change; according to the supplier, the part arrives Thursday.
words.es: Lamento el cambio; según el proveedor, la pieza llega el jueves.

words.en: Could you tell me if that time works for your business?
words.es: ¿Me podría decir si ese horario le funciona para su negocio?

words.en: I'm leaving you a message; please call me back.
words.es: Le dejo un mensaje; por favor, devuélvame la llamada.

words.en: I would recommend moving the stock to another cooler during the shutdown.
words.es: Le recomendaría pasar la mercancía a otra cámara durante el corte.

words.en: Hi, could you confirm the Saturday time for me?
words.es: Hola, ¿podrías confirmarme el horario del sábado?

lessons.speaking: You are the electrician, and the AI is the owner of a small shop with refrigerated stock: call to move the planned shutdown, using ¿podríamos...? and le escribo para confirmar, then confirm the new time politely.

grammar.focus: Phone and text conventions; conditional politeness (¿podríamos...?, le escribo para confirmar)

examples.es: ¿Podríamos cambiar la hora del corte?
examples.en: Could we change the time of the shutdown?

examples.es: Le escribo para confirmar el nuevo horario.
examples.en: I'm writing to confirm the new schedule.

lessons.title: Final Walkthrough and Warranty Limits
lessons.objective: Walk a homeowner through finished work, explain what the warranty covers, and give the conditions kindly.

words.en: It covers my labor, as long as nobody modifies the installation.
words.es: Cubre mi mano de obra, siempre que nadie modifique la instalación.

words.en: It doesn't cover appliances, unless the fault comes from my installation.
words.es: No cubre aparatos, a menos que la falla sea de mi instalación.

words.en: In case you see smoke, get out and call 911.
words.es: En caso de que vea humo, salga y llame al 911.

words.en: Promising coverage for everything wouldn't be honest of me.
words.es: Prometer cobertura para todo no sería honesto de mi parte.

words.en: I would come check it at no cost if it were an installation defect.
words.es: Vendría a revisarlo sin costo si fuera un defecto de instalación.

words.en: The permit closes when the inspector gives the sign-off.
words.es: El permiso se cierra cuando el inspector dé su visto bueno.

words.en: I'm leaving you the paperwork and phone number to call me when you need it.
words.es: Le dejo el comprobante y el teléfono para llamarme cuando lo necesite.

words.en: I understand you want peace of mind; I'll explain what I cover and what I don't.
words.es: Entiendo que quiere tranquilidad; le explico qué cubro y qué no.

lessons.speaking: You are the electrician at the finished job, and the AI is a homeowner who wants a promise of coverage for anything electrical: walk through the work, explain permit closeout and warranty limits kindly, using siempre que, a menos que and en caso de que.

grammar.focus: Conditional; subjunctive in conditions (siempre que, a menos que, en caso de que)

examples.es: Cubro la instalación, siempre que nadie la modifique.
examples.en: I cover the installation, as long as nobody modifies it.

examples.es: En caso de que se dispare el breaker, llámeme.
examples.en: In case the breaker trips, call me.

lessons.title: Capstone: A Full Day After a Basement Flood
lessons.objective: Lead a hard day of flood-damaged panel repair, from safe entry to final walkthrough, entirely in Spanish.

words.en: Don't enter the water until we verify there's no power.
words.es: No entren al agua hasta que verifiquemos que no hay corriente.

words.en: I want you to explain how you verify before touching anything.
words.es: Quiero que me expliques cómo verificas antes de tocar algo.

words.en: I noted in the report that the water had reached the bus bars.
words.es: Anoté en el informe que el agua había llegado hasta las barras.

words.en: If the part is still out of stock, what approved alternative do you recommend?
words.es: Si la pieza sigue agotada, ¿qué alternativa aprobada me recomienda?

words.en: Inspector, I'll explain what we found and how we'll correct it.
words.es: Inspector, le explico lo que encontramos y cómo vamos a corregirlo.

words.en: We almost touched a wet conductor; we stopped and measured again.
words.es: Casi tocamos un conductor mojado; paramos y volvimos a medir.

words.en: Let's take a break; if you're tired, it's easier to make mistakes.
words.es: Hagamos una pausa; si están cansados, es más fácil cometer errores.

words.en: Ma'am, if the inspector approves, we can reconnect the power tomorrow.
words.es: Señora, si el inspector aprueba, podremos reconectar la luz mañana.

lessons.speaking: You are the lead electrician after a basement flood, and the AI is your apprentice, the inspector and the homeowner in turn: lead safe entry, teach verification, report, and close out using commands, connectors, past tenses, subjunctive and usted.

grammar.focus: Capstone: integrating the Master 20 grammar (connectors, commands, preterite/imperfect, subjunctive, formal register)

examples.es: Quiero que verifiques el circuito antes de que lo toquemos.
examples.en: I want you to verify the circuit before we touch it.

examples.es: Mientras medíamos, vimos que el agua había subido.
examples.en: While we were measuring, we saw that the water had risen.
